bugs.title: Silent exception handling in convergence logic
bugs.description: Rescue blocks in convergence module swallow errors without adequate logging, masking runtime failures.

bugs.title: Unguarded pattern match in pair_runner dispatch

bugs.title: Phase transition errors not logged
bugs.description: Phase transition failures silently return error tuples without logging diagnostic context.

bugs.title: Unreachable clause in cycle cap logic
bugs.description: Dead code branch that can never be reached due to preceding pattern match.

bugs.title: Missing guard on checkpoint input validation
bugs.description: Human checkpoint accepts external input without validating structure.

bugs.title: Unused alias or import in metrics module
bugs.description: Module contains unused alias that should be cleaned up.

bugs.title: Missing timeout consideration in awaiting operator
bugs.description: Awaiting operator state could wait indefinitely without timeout mechanism.

bugs.title: Missing timeout in collect_output/2 receive block
bugs.description: collect_output/2 has no timeout on its receive block. If port communication fails, the process hangs indefinitely. Fixed by adding 30-second timeout.

bugs.title: Missing :closed pattern clause for unexpected port termination
bugs.description: No clause handles unexpected port termination, causing MatchError when port closes unexpectedly.

bugs.title: Turn.emit_issue_events/5 silently swallows failures

bugs.title: Transcripts.task_id/1 missing catch-all clause

bugs.description: Invalid input types cause FunctionClauseError instead of returning a meaningful error.

bugs.title: TOCTOU race condition in RoutingOverride.apply_override/4

bugs.title: String.to_existing_atom/1 could fail on missing atoms

bugs.title: String.to_existing_atom/1 could fail on missing atoms
bugs.description: Unsafe atom conversion in CodexAppServer driver, caught by rescue but could silently fail.

bugs.title: ToolProfile nil phase_map handling ambiguity

bugs.title: ClaudeCode.decode_lines error missing context
bugs.description: Error tuple lacks context about expected type for better debugging.

bugs.title: Unlogged rescue/catch in bound_port
bugs.description: Rescue and catch blocks in bound_port/1 swallow errors without logging.

bugs.title: Inconsistent result binding in maybe_set_server_port
bugs.description: Return value from dependency not properly propagated.

bugs.title: Infinite wait in wait_for_shutdown (no timeout)

bugs.title: Unvalidated symlink conversion in path safety

bugs.title: Missing timeout parameter guard in orchestrator

bugs.title: Unguarded pattern match in find_issue_id_for_ref

bugs.title: Missing error context in build_prompt

bugs.title: Missing empty string validation in parse_host

bugs.title: Redundant error clause in parse/1
bugs.description: Error clause is unreachable due to preceding pattern matches.

bugs.title: stop_port/1 unguarded pattern match on non-port values
bugs.description: Missing catch-all clause for non-port values causes MatchError when called with nil.

bugs.title: Missing receive_timeout on Req.post() in Linear client

bugs.title: Workspace.remove/2 return type mismatch

bugs.title: LogFile.remove_existing_handler/0 swallows handler removal errors

bugs.title: SSH.start_port/3 missing error clause in with block

bugs.title: POST API endpoints lack CSRF protection
bugs.description: All POST routes are unprotected against cross-site request forgery. State-changing operations can be triggered by malicious third-party pages.

bugs.title: Weak hardcoded secret_key_base
bugs.description: secret_key_base uses String.duplicate('s', 64) — trivially guessable. Should load from environment variable.

bugs.title: check_origin: false disables WebSocket origin validation
bugs.description: WebSocket connections accept any origin, enabling cross-site WebSocket hijacking.

bugs.title: Hardcoded LiveView signing salt
bugs.description: LiveView signing salt is hardcoded. Should load from environment variable.

bugs.title: Inline onclick JavaScript handler in dashboard
bugs.description: Dashboard uses inline onclick handler, bypassing CSP protections.

bugs.title: Docker containers missing healthchecks
bugs.description: Worker services have no healthcheck configuration, preventing proper orchestration.

bugs.title: Docker containers missing restart policy
bugs.description: No restart policy defined; containers won't auto-recover from crashes.

bugs.title: All API endpoints lack authorization checks

bugs.title: Uncaught crashes from Config.settings!().duet calls
